name: Brian Schatz

pages.title: Brian Schatz for Hawaii - Brian Schatz
pages.text:
Schatz for Senate
As chair of the Special Committee on the Climate Crisis, @BrianSchatz is fighting for bold action that protects Hawai‘i’s residents on the front lines of the climate crisis. We're proud to endorse Senator Schatz in his re-election campaign!
October is LGBT History Month and Pride Month in Honolulu, so we’re launching a new line of Pride merch!
NOW OPEN: The new Team Schatz online store is live with tons of new merch. Check it out today. 👇 https://shop.brianschatz.com/
Brian is fighting for urgent climate action:
✔️ Reduce greenhouse gas emissions
✔️ Build a clean-energy economy
✔️ Make environmental justice a top priority
He’ll need a strong grassroots team to keep fighting in Washington. #EarthDay
In 2020, we raised millions of dollars for Democrats -- and it worked. We flipped the Senate.
Now, Brian is up for re-election and today is the first FEC deadline since we launched our campaign. If you can, chip in a few dollars. Every dollar matters.👇
